items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 October 2026 10:46pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 22 October 2026 at 10:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gales.


##Synopsis##

Very weak ridge of high pressure at first will decline, deep low pressure will move eastwards through the English Channel tonight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

East 5 to 7, backing North or Northeast towards the end of tonight, then backing Northwest 7 or gale 8 tomorrow morning. Little change in afternoon, decreasing West or Northwest 6 or 7 in evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, building moderate or rough later tonight.


##Weather##

Heavy rain tonight, gradually clearing tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Northwest 6 or 7, decreasing West or Southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Saturday. Increasing South 7 to severe gale 9 Saturday morning then veering West or Southwest gale 8 or severe gale 9 later in day.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, falling moderate overnight into Saturday, building rough or very rough by late Saturday morning.


##Weather##

Fair, then heavy rain.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
